# The generated files of the schema-driven codec (core/tools/uo-schema). One schema per line:
#   <schema.uos> rust=<file> ts=<file> [rust_support=<file>] [ts_support=<file>] [ts_runtime=<file>]
# Every path is relative to core/. `cargo run -p uo-schema -- generate` rewrites the files; CI runs
# `cargo run -p uo-schema -- check` and fails when a committed file differs from what the schema generates.
# rust_support goes beside rust (a sibling module, `#[cfg(test)]`): the canonical dump and the random messages of the tests.
schema/render.uos rust=crates/uo-render/src/codec/generated.rs ts=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/render.ts rust_support=crates/uo-render/src/codec/generated_support.rs ts_support=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/render.support.ts
schema/write.uos rust=crates/uo-docx-layout/src/codec/generated.rs ts=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/write.ts rust_support=crates/uo-docx-layout/src/codec/generated_support.rs ts_support=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/write.support.ts
tools/uo-schema/tests/schemas/codec_test.uos rust=tools/uo-schema/tests/fixtures/codec_test.rs ts=tools/uo-schema/tests/fixtures/codec_test.ts rust_support=tools/uo-schema/tests/fixtures/codec_test_support.rs ts_support=tools/uo-schema/tests/fixtures/codec_test.support.ts
schema/session.uos rust=crates/uo-wasm/src/session/codec/generated.rs ts=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/session.ts rust_support=crates/uo-wasm/src/session/codec/generated_support.rs ts_support=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/session.support.ts rust_bind=crates/uo-wasm/src/session/codec/bind.rs bind=schema/session.bind
tools/uo-schema/tests/schemas/bind_test.uos rust=tools/uo-schema/tests/fixtures/bind_test.rs rust_support=tools/uo-schema/tests/fixtures/bind_test_support.rs rust_bind=tools/uo-schema/tests/fixtures/bind_test_bind.rs bind=tools/uo-schema/tests/schemas/bind_test.bind
schema/slides.uos rust=crates/uo-render/src/codec/slides_generated.rs ts=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/slides.ts rust_support=crates/uo-render/src/codec/slides_generated_support.rs ts_support=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/slides.support.ts
schema/slots.uos rust=crates/uo-render/src/codec/slots_generated.rs ts=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/slots.ts rust_support=crates/uo-render/src/codec/slots_generated_support.rs ts_support=crates/uo-wasm/js/gen/slots.support.ts
